title: First Missing Positive

story.title: Every Crate to Its Own Slot
story.text: Crate v belongs in slot v-1. A worker keeps swapping each crate into its home slot until it's home, out of range, or a duplicate. The first slot holding the wrong crate gives the answer.
story.goal: Return the smallest missing positive integer, in O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
